nexgn-origin-story.title: The Nexgn origin story: What a global search taught us about broken document workflows
nexgn-origin-story.excerpt: Growing a company introduces a structural problem that founders rarely anticipate: document workflow fragmentation. This is the story of how an exhaustive on-ground survey revealed the true root cause of document chaos, and how we engineered Nexgn to fix it.

intro.p1: Growing a company introduces a structural problem that founders rarely anticipate: document workflow fragmentation. What begins as a simple process for managing client agreements rapidly degrades into a chaotic mix of emails, disconnected signing applications, and lost files. The consequence is delayed deal closures, frustrated teams, and severe compliance risks.
intro.p2: This is the story of how an exhaustive on-ground survey revealed the true root cause of document chaos, and how we engineered Nexgn to fix it.

why-scaling-businesses-struggle.tocLabel: Why do scaling businesses struggle with document execution?
why-scaling-businesses-struggle.heading: Why do scaling businesses struggle with document execution?
why-scaling-businesses-struggle.p1: Businesses struggle because the document lifecycle—drafting, reviewing, approving, and signing—is split across too many disconnected platforms, forcing employees to act as manual data routers.
why-scaling-businesses-struggle.p2: You likely recognize the symptoms in your own daily operations. A standard vendor contract is drafted in a cloud document, emailed to a manager for internal review, uploaded manually to a standalone digital signature portal, downloaded once signed, and finally dragged into a shared storage drive.
why-scaling-businesses-struggle.p3: When your team processes five contracts a month, this is a minor annoyance. When you process fifty, it becomes an operational crisis. Tracking the status of a critical document becomes impossible. Approvals stall because an email notification was missed. Your team spends expensive administrative hours simply moving information from one software silo to another.

the-on-ground-reality.tocLabel: The on-ground reality: Testing our assumptions
the-on-ground-reality.heading: The on-ground reality: Testing our assumptions
the-on-ground-reality.p1: When operations break down, the default startup instinct is to build a cheaper, faster software tool to replace an existing one. We initially assumed the market just needed a more affordable digital signature application.
the-on-ground-reality.p2: Before writing a single line of code, we decided to validate that assumption. We left our desks and initiated an extensive on-ground survey across India. We sat in the offices of startup founders and operations managers across Bangalore, Mumbai, Jaipur, Delhi, Noida, and Gurugram.
the-on-ground-reality.p3: To ensure we were not just seeing a localized problem, we expanded the research globally. We ran virtual feedback sessions with the co-partners of NoCapCode operating out of New Mexico, Washington DC, and London. We asked them to show us exactly how they executed contracts and managed internal approvals.

the-aha-moment.tocLabel: The Aha Moment: The signature is not the bottleneck
the-aha-moment.heading: The Aha Moment: The signature is not the bottleneck
the-aha-moment.p1: Sitting in those feedback sessions delivered a critical insight that completely changed our product roadmap.
the-aha-moment.p2: We realized that purchasing another specialized digital signature application actually worsens workflow fragmentation.
the-aha-moment.p3: The founders and operations managers we interviewed did not have a signature problem; they had a workflow visibility problem. The actual friction was never the digital signature itself. The friction was the manual handoff before and after the signature.
the-aha-moment.p4: Founders explicitly told us they did not want another app to log into. They wanted the manual routing between departments to disappear. Adding more disconnected software to a broken process just creates faster chaos.

how-we-built-the-solution.heading: How we built the solution
how-we-built-the-solution.p1: Armed with that realization, we scrapped the idea of building just another signature tool. We engineered a highly focused prototype designed to act as a unified operational source of truth.
how-we-built-the-solution.p2: Nexgn centralizes document ownership. It connects secure, legally binding digital signatures directly with automated workflow routing. Instead of an employee manually uploading and downloading files between platforms, Nexgn automates the handoffs. You define the approval chain, and the platform ensures the document moves seamlessly from the reviewer to the final signatory, automatically logging an enterprise-grade audit trail at every step.
how-we-built-the-solution.p3: The success of this prototype in early beta testing proved our thesis and secured strategic sponsorship from NoCapCode Inc., giving us the infrastructure to scale into an enterprise-grade SaaS platform.

take-action-on-your-workflow.heading: Take action on your workflow
take-action-on-your-workflow.p1: Assess the hidden administrative costs of your current contract execution process before you purchase another disconnected software tool. If your team is acting as manual routers for your documents, the Nexgn V2 Public Beta is now live. Centralize your workflows and get back to building your business.

shift-to-aes-256.title: Zero-Trust Envelopes: Inside Our AES-256 & SHA-256 Security Pipeline
shift-to-aes-256.excerpt: Building trust at scale requires more than just digital signatures. Discover how getting the cryptographic architecture right protects every byte.

intro.p1: When sensitive agreements cross organizational boundaries, transport encryption alone is never enough. Every document processed through Nexgn passes through a multi-stage cryptographic pipeline designed to guarantee both confidentiality and tamper-evidence.
intro.p2: Here is how our security engineering team architected zero-trust envelope handling from the ground up.

encryption-at-rest.heading: Block-Level AES-256-GCM Encryption
encryption-at-rest.p1: All PDF binaries, signature strokes, and audit metadata are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM and transmitted exclusively over TLS 1.3 with Perfect Forward Secrecy. Even before a document reaches your connected Google Drive, its payload is isolated inside ephemeral memory buffers.
encryption-at-rest.p2: By combining TOTP two-factor authentication (RFC 6238) with granular role-based access control, workspace administrators maintain complete authority over who can prepare, route, or void an envelope.

tamper-evident-sealing.heading: Tamper-Evident SHA-256 Digital Seals
tamper-evident-sealing.p1: Upon final signature execution, Nexgn computes a deterministic SHA-256 checksum across the flattened PDF and its forensic audit certificate. Any subsequent alteration to the file immediately breaks the hash match during verification.

navigating-it-act-2000.title: Navigating the Indian IT Act 2000 & Global eSignature Laws for SaaS
navigating-it-act-2000.excerpt: A comprehensive breakdown of Section 65B, US ESIGN, and EU eIDAS—and how to ensure your digital signatures are court-admissible worldwide.

intro.p1: Cross-border agreements demand an evidentiary trail that satisfies multiple legal jurisdictions simultaneously. Whether your counterparty is signing in Bengaluru, San Francisco, or Berlin, the validity of an electronic signature rests on intent, consent, and verifiable attribution.

it-act-section-65b.heading: IT Act 2000 & Section 65B Admissibility
it-act-section-65b.p1: Under Sections 5 and 10A of India’s Information Technology Act, 2000, contracts formed electronically carry full legal recognition. To satisfy Section 65B of the Indian Evidence Act, Nexgn automatically records immutable UTC timestamps, IPv4/IPv6 addresses, and browser User-Agent strings inside every Audit Certificate.

esign-ueta-eidas.tocLabel: Aligning with US ESIGN, UETA & EU eIDAS
esign-ueta-eidas.heading: Aligning with US ESIGN, UETA & EU eIDAS
esign-ueta-eidas.p1: Before any signature is applied, Nexgn captures explicit affirmative consent to conduct business electronically—fulfilling US ESIGN Act and UETA mandates as well as EU eIDAS Article 25 requirements for Standard Electronic Signatures.

designing-frictionless-workflows.excerpt: How optimizing the mobile signing flow and eliminating account walls increases completion speed by 60%.

intro.p1: Every extra click in a signing flow costs conversion. When we studied why agreements stall in enterprise HR and sales pipelines, the culprit was almost always forced account creation and clumsy mobile PDF zooming.

zero-account-signing.heading: Zero-Account Guest Execution
zero-account-signing.p1: We designed Nexgn so signers can open an agreement link on any smartphone, step directly to their assigned fields, and sign with a natural touch gesture or curated calligraphic typeface—with zero login walls.

pixel-perfect-coordinates.heading: Pixel-Perfect Responsive Coordinates
pixel-perfect-coordinates.p1: By anchoring every text, date, radio, and signature widget relative to the PDF page geometry, documents look identical whether prepared on a 4K studio display or signed on a compact mobile screen.

webhooks-vs-polling.title: Webhooks vs Polling: Building Real-Time Agreement Integrations
webhooks-vs-polling.excerpt: Architectural patterns for syncing document statuses between Nexgn and your internal CRMs using HMAC-SHA256 webhooks.

intro.p1: Polling an API every minute to check if a contract has been signed wastes compute, hits rate limits, and delays downstream provisioning. Event-driven webhooks turn agreement completion into an instant trigger.

event-driven-webhooks.heading: Sub-Second Event Dispatch
event-driven-webhooks.p1: The moment a recipient views, signs, or completes an envelope, Nexgn dispatches a structured JSON payload to your configured webhook endpoint—allowing your backend to unlock onboarding or trigger invoicing in real time.

hmac-verification.heading: Verifying Payloads with HMAC-SHA256
hmac-verification.p1: Every webhook request includes a cryptographic signature header computed with your endpoint secret, ensuring your servers only process authentic events originating from Nexgn.

sustainable-code-reductions.title: Sustainable Code: Reducing Paper Waste and Data Center Emissions
sustainable-code-reductions.excerpt: We measure everything from Node process memory to payload compression so every digital agreement leaves a smaller footprint.

green-cloud-engineering.heading: Lean Bundles & Ephemeral Compute
green-cloud-engineering.p1: By building on React 19 and Rsbuild with aggressive asset compression and zero-retention ephemeral workers, Nexgn minimizes redundant data duplication and lowers per-envelope compute energy across our infrastructure.

cp-f1.q: How do I upload a document and prepare it for signing?
cp-f1.a: Click "New Envelope" on your dashboard, upload your PDF, and use our Document Editor to drag-and-drop necessary fields (Signature, Date, Text, Name, Number) onto the document. Assign a recipient and click send.

cp-f2.a: Currently, Nexgn supports PDF files to ensure pixel-perfect rendering and coordinate precision across all devices.

cp-f3.q: Can I save a frequently used document as a template?
cp-f3.a: Yes. Upload your document, assign dynamic roles (e.g., "Contractor", "Hiring Manager"), place your fields, and save it as a Template. Next time, you only need to enter the recipient's email.

cp-f4.q: How do I set up automated reminders for signers?
cp-f4.a: During the document preparation phase, open the "Automate" tab. You can configure Smart Reminders to follow up with the signer automatically (e.g., every 3 days) until the document expires or is signed.

cp-f5.q: How do I create multi-signer sequential workflows?
cp-f5.a: When adding signers, you can define a routing order. For example, assign the Tenant as Step 1, the Broker as Step 2, and the Landlord as Step 3. The document will route to each party sequentially.

cp-r1.q: Is it possible to schedule a document to be sent at a later date?
cp-r1.a: Yes. Using the Scheduler feature, you can queue an envelope to be dispatched at a specific date and time, completely handled by our backend queueing system.

cp-r2.q: What happens if I place a signature field outside the document margins?
cp-r2.a: Our Document Editor restricts widgets to the document's viewable canvas to ensure that signatures and data are clearly visible and legally binding on the final exported PDF.

cp-r3.q: Can I edit a document after it has been sent?
cp-r3.a: No. To preserve the cryptographic integrity and legal validity of the agreement, a document cannot be edited once dispatched. You must void the envelope and send a corrected version.

se-f1.q: Does the person signing need a Nexgn account?
se-f1.a: No. Signers do not need to create an account, enter a password, or pay any fees. They simply click the secure link in their email to access the document.

se-f2.q: Can signers complete documents on a mobile device?
se-f2.a: Absolutely. Nexgn provides a frictionless, mobile-first portal optimized for smartphones and tablets.

se-f3.q: What signature styles are available to the signer?
se-f3.a: Signers can draw their signature using a trackpad/touchscreen, upload an image of their signature, or type their name using one of our four custom cursive fonts (including Caveat, Dancing Script, Great Vibes, and Pacifico).

se-f4.q: How does the signer receive the final executed document?
se-f4.a: Once all parties have signed, all participants automatically receive an email containing a secure link to download the finalized PDF and its attached Audit Certificate.

se-r1.q: How does the "Consent Overlay" work before signing?
se-r1.a: Before viewing the document, signers must accept a mandatory "Electronic Record and Signature Consent" overlay. This establishes explicit legal intent to conduct business electronically.

se-r2.q: What happens if a signer declines to sign?
se-r2.a: A signer can choose "Decline to Sign" within the portal and leave an optional reason. The envelope status will update to "Declined," and the sender will be notified immediately.

se-r3.q: What if the signer forwards their unique signing link to someone else?
se-r3.a: Signing links are uniquely tokenized and tied to the recipient's email address and session. If a link is forwarded, our telemetry will log the differing IP and browser details in the audit trail, though we recommend strict email security to prevent unauthorized access.

se-r4.q: Can a signer change their signature after completing the document?
se-r4.a: No. Once the "Complete" button is pressed, the document is immediately sealed with a SHA-256 cryptographic hash. Changes cannot be made without breaking the document's legal integrity.

sc-f3.q: How does Nexgn prove the identity of the signer?
sc-f3.a: We utilize a Telemetry Matrix that captures the signer's verified email address, IPv4/IPv6 network addresses, exact UTC server timestamps, and browser/OS User-Agent strings.

sc-f5.q: What happens if a document is tampered with after signing?
sc-f5.a: Every completed agreement is sealed with a tamper-evident SHA-256 hash. If a single pixel or character is altered after execution, the cryptographic seal breaks, immediately voiding the document.

sc-r1.q: Do you offer Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for accounts?
sc-r1.a: Yes. We highly recommend securing your Nexgn workspace with our mandatory TOTP Two-Factor Authentication via authenticator apps (like Google Authenticator or Authy).

sc-r2.q: Are you SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified?
sc-r2.a: Nexgn’s platform is built on top of Tier-1 cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) that is independently certified for ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and PCI-DSS.

sc-r3.q: How does Nexgn satisfy "Advanced Electronic Signatures" (AES) in the EU?
sc-r3.a: Our comprehensive audit telemetry (IP, email authentication, document hashing, and timestamps) provides the necessary evidence to support AES standards under the eIDAS regulation.

sc-r4.q: How do I report a security vulnerability?
sc-r4.a: Nexgn maintains a Vulnerability Disclosure Program. Ethical hackers can report issues to our security team (with PGP encryption support) to help us continually secure the platform.

ab-f2.a: We will notify you when you reach 80% capacity. Once you hit your limit, you will be temporarily blocked from sending further requests until your billing cycle resets on the 1st of the month, or you can instantly upgrade to the Business plan for unlimited envelopes.

ab-f3.q: How do I upgrade, downgrade, or cancel my subscription?
ab-f3.a: You can manage your subscription directly from your Workspace Settings. Upgrades take effect immediately. Cancellations leave your paid features active until the end of your current billing cycle.

ab-f5.q: How do I add team members to my workspace?
ab-f5.a: On the Starter and Business plans, you can invite team members as Sub-Admins via the Team Management dashboard.

ab-r1.q: How does Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) work?
ab-r1.a: Workspace Admins can strictly restrict Sub-Admin permissions. You can toggle specific capabilities, such as Can View Documents, Can Create Templates, or Can Manage Billing, ensuring sensitive contracts remain confidential.

esg-f2.q: How does the Live Impact Tracker work?

esg-f4.a: By moving agreements online, you directly eliminate paper usage, physical printer ink, transit emissions from courier shipping, and physical storage bloat.

esg-r1.q: How do you ensure your impact numbers aren't "greenwashing"?
esg-r1.a: We maintain absolute transparency. We openly publish the mathematical methodology behind our Live Impact Tracker (e.g., standard calculations for water and wood saved per ream of paper) so our metrics are verifiable.

esg-r2.q: Can I view my specific company's environmental impact?

ai-f2.q: Will my confidential contracts be used to train AI models?

pillars.eyebrow: The Core Elements of a Legal eSignature
pillars.title: How Nexgn Ensures Legal Enforceability
pillars.text: To be legally binding, an electronic signature must satisfy four core legal pillars. Nexgn’s architecture automates compliance for all of them:

intent.title: Intent to Sign
intent.text: Signers are clearly prompted to type, draw, or upload their signature, proving deliberate intent to execute the document.

consent.title: Explicit Consent
consent.text: Mandatory “Electronic Record and Signature Consent” overlays must be accepted by the signer before the document can even be viewed.

association.title: Signer Association
association.text: Nexgn ties the signature directly to the signer via secure email links, session tokens, and IP address (IPv4/IPv6) telemetry.

integrity.title: Document Integrity
integrity.text: Upon completion, the document is sealed with a SHA-256 cryptographic hash. Any post-signature tampering instantly breaks the seal and invalidates the file.

us.label: United States
us.laws: ESIGN Act (Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act) & UETA (Uniform Electronic Transactions Act).
us.stance: Nexgn fully complies with the ESIGN Act and UETA. Signatures collected via Nexgn carry the same legal weight as traditional paper signatures in all 50 states for broad commercial, B2B, and B2C transactions.

eu.label: EU & UK
eu.laws: eIDAS Regulation (EU No. 910/2014) and the UK Electronic Communications Act 2000 / UK eIDAS.
eu.stance: Nexgn supports Simple and Advanced Electronic Signatures, backed by a full audit trail, which are admissible as evidence and cannot be denied legal effect solely because they are electronic.

in.label: India
in.laws: Information Technology Act, 2000 (including Sections 3A and 10A) and the Indian Evidence Act framework.
in.stance: Contracts concluded through electronic means are valid and enforceable in India. Nexgn’s signer identity, timestamp and integrity evidence is designed to support admissibility of electronic records.

row.label: Rest of the World
row.laws: UNCITRAL Model Law on Electronic Commerce and Electronic Signatures, and national laws based on it.
row.stance: Most jurisdictions recognize electronic signatures under laws modelled on UNCITRAL. Because rules vary by country and document type, we recommend confirming requirements with local counsel.

evidence.title: Why Digital is More Secure Than Paper

principles.title: Our Commitment to Your Data

minimization.title: Data Minimization
minimization.text: We only collect the data strictly necessary to execute the agreement and generate a legally binding Audit Certificate. If we don’t need it, we don’t ask for it.

ownership.title: You Own Your Data

monetization.title: Zero Monetization
monetization.text: We make money by providing excellent software subscriptions, never by selling your proprietary contract data or signer telemetry to third-party data brokers.

collection.title: Data Collection for Legal Evidence
collection.text: To ensure that your electronic signatures hold up in court under frameworks like the US ESIGN Act, the EU eIDAS, and the India IT Act, Nexgn must capture specific telemetry to prove the intent and identity of the signer.

byos.title: Decentralized Storage for Maximum Privacy

byos.howText: When you connect Nexgn to your Google Workspace, signed agreements and their corresponding Audit Certificates are automatically synced directly to your secure Google Drive folder.
byos.retentionText: Unless explicitly configured otherwise in your workspace settings, Nexgn does not indefinitely store your completed PDFs on our servers. Once the execution is complete and the file is synced to your drive, our primary job is done.

ai.title: Responsible AI & Your Confidential Data

training.title: Zero Training
training.text: Nexgn does NOT use your confidential contracts, signatures, or uploaded templates to train our own, or any third-party, foundational AI models.

ephemeral.title: Ephemeral Processing
ephemeral.text: When you utilize our AI tools to summarize a contract, the document text is processed securely and the resulting data is discarded immediately after the summary is generated.

optin.title: Opt-In Only
optin.text: AI features are strictly opt-in. Workspace Admins can globally disable AI processing for their entire organization with a single toggle in the settings dashboard.

gdpr.text: Nexgn is designed to support General Data Protection Regulation compliance. We facilitate Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs), support the “Right to be Forgotten,” and provide a standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA) for our EU customers.

dpdp.text: We are aligning our infrastructure with the phased rollout of India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Rules 2025. We prioritize explicit consent mechanisms (like our Signer Consent Overlays) and strict purpose limitation for all collected telemetry.

ccpa.text: We comply with the California Consumer Privacy Act. Nexgn does not sell personal information. California residents can easily exercise their data rights by contacting our privacy team.
